title: I'll call you, I promise
goal: Promise, offer, guess what will happen and say what is always so with -Ar.

intro.text: The general present is for what will probably happen (*Belki ertir ýagyş ýagar*), promises (*Men ertir jaň ederin*), offers (*Çaý içersiňizmi?*) and what is always so (*Gyşda gar ýagar*). It is also how you say goodbye until next time: *Ertir duşuşarys!*

vocab.en: to promise (literally to give your word)
God willing, if all goes well

exercises.question: Which sentence is a promise: **I'll help you**?

why.1: *kömek edýärin* is **I'm helping you**, now or as a plan: not a promise.
why.2: *kömek etdim* is the past: **I helped you**.

exercises.explain: A promise made now: the general present, *kömek ederin*.

reject.why: *ýagýar* says **it's raining**, or a fixed plan. For a guess about tomorrow: *ýagar*.

exercises.explain: A guess about the future: the general present, *ýagar*.

reject.why: *jaň edýärin* is **I'm calling**, now or as a plan. A promise made now: *jaň ederin*.

exercises.question: Which sentence says what is always so?

why.1: That is happening now: **it's snowing now**.
why.2: That is the past: **it snowed yesterday**.

exercises.explain: *Gyşda gar ýagar*: it snows in winter, as it always does.

exercises.prompt: It rains a lot in autumn.
exercises.explain: What is always so: *ýagar* (or *ýagýar*). *Güýz* + *-de*: in autumn.

exercises.label: *gitmek* in the general present: I go, I'll go…
exercises.explain: *git-* changes its *t* to *d* before a vowel: *gider*, as in *gidýär*.

exercises.prompt: Indiki ýyl Mara bararyn, nesip bolsa.
accept: Next year I'll go to Mary, God willing.
Next year I'll go to Mary, [hopefully|if all goes well].
I'll go to Mary next year, [God willing|hopefully|if all goes well].
[God willing|Hopefully], I'll go to Mary next year.

exercises.question: When would you say *Çaý içersiňizmi?*
options: to ask what someone is drinking right now
to ask what someone drank yesterday

why.1: That would be *Häzir näme içýärsiňiz?*: what is happening uses `-ýAr`.
why.2: That would be the past: *Düýn näme içdiňiz?*

exercises.explain: *içersiňizmi?* is the general present: **will you have some tea?**, a polite offer.

reject.why: *geljek* doesn't say who. Say the subject: *Elbetde, ol geljek*, or use *geler*.

exercises.explain: The farewell uses the general present: *Ertir duşuşarys!*, literally **we'll meet tomorrow**. *duşuşýarys* would state a plan, and *duşuşdyk* is the past.
What is always so: *Pişik süýt içer*. The singular can stand for every cat.
